body:
## Description:
Adds the Roman Hastati from the Roman Republic period to the game. Includes a full custom armor set, two new weapons, and a Roman shield with six color and pattern variants

![Roman Hastati](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/70d19ccdebb3e98a5878d7caf40f335963a65d9b.png)

## Armor:

The armor is comparable to iron but uses copper and leather for crafting!

![Hastati armor](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d34c7885728c8fb9483b5b1cafe2a8eae1c5b893_0.webp)

## Weapons:

### Gladius:
A short iron sword with high attack speed.

### Pilum:
A ranged javelin with the unique ability to disable shields on hit, also gives enemy a brief slow if not blocked.

### Scutum:
Large Roman shield with unique customisable Roman inspired patterns.

![New Weapons!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0b3119bdcb9062a8de4ab65b9c33eec7cbdd4321_0.webp)

## Custom shield decorations:

![Shield patterns](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1e48ea91890060f3f73a7c0b46ece03bc607d661_0.webp)
